runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:327:## Connect, remove, or reset workspaces
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-328-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-329-Each nanobot instance uses one configured Linear OAuth app, which may have
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:330:multiple workspace installations. A **private** app can only be installed in its
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:331:own workspace. To use the same app in another workspace, its distribution must
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-332-allow that installation in Linear; changing a nanobot field cannot bypass this.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-333-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:334:- **Connect workspace** uses the current app and opens the same browser
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:335:  authorization flow. Choose the other workspace in Linear, review team access,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-336-  and authorize. You do not need another HTTPS address or another set of app
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:337:  credentials for the same app. Review member access in the new workspace.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:338:- **… → Reauthorize** on a workspace updates its connection, without creating a
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-339-  duplicate or clearing its member choices. Use it to renew authorization or
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-340-  grant missing scopes. Cancelling authorization leaves existing connections alone.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:341:- **… → Remove workspace** revokes that workspace's tokens and clears its local
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:342:  installation and member switches. Other workspaces are unaffected. Removing
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:343:  the last workspace also stops the channel. App credentials remain available
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-344-  for connecting again.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-345-- **Advanced → Reset Linear connection** removes all installations for the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-346-  current app, stops the channel, and clears this instance's Linear app settings,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-347-  including its saved credentials. Use this when starting over or switching apps.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:348:  If a step fails, the UI reports an incomplete reset; removed workspaces stay
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-349-  removed, and you can retry the remaining steps.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-350-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-351-If authorization changes while a member refresh or removal is in progress,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-352-nanobot discards the stale result instead of restoring a removed connection or
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:353:overwriting a new authorization. Refresh the workspace/member list and retry the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-354-action against the current connection.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-355-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:356:Neither removal nor reset deletes the Linear workspace, app, issues or comments,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:357:nor nanobot conversation history or pairing approvals. Deleting the app itself
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:358:is a separate action in Linear. After removing and reconnecting a workspace,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-359-member switches start fresh, but retained pairing approvals or an `allowFrom`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:360:entry can still grant access. **Reset is not a wipe of all authorization history.**
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-361-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-480-| OAuth finishes in Linear but nanobot keeps waiting | Keep the nanobot connection dialog open. Confirm the Redirect URI reaches the same nanobot process, and inspect gateway logs for callback or token exchange errors. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:481:| A secret shows **Saved**, but no readable value | This is expected. The secret is stored on this instance and not returned to the browser. Use **Replace → Save** only when changing it. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:482:| Another workspace is unavailable during authorization | Check the current app's distribution and your installation permissions in Linear. A private app only works in its own workspace. **Connect workspace** does not create a new app. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-483-| The local health URL does not load | Start **Connect Linear** or enable the connected channel, then check the configured listen host and port. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:484:| **Agent didn't start**, **nanobot failed to start**, or a session stays on **Thinking…** without a response | First check **Webhooks → Delivery status** in the Linear app. If **Disabled**, enable it from **…**. Confirm the current Webhook URL and `AgentSessionEvent` subscription, then select **Retry** in the Linear session. OAuth success and a working `/linear/health` endpoint do not prove that Linear is sending events. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:485:| An @mention still gets no response with delivery enabled | Inspect **Webhook delivery failures** in the Linear app and run `nanobot gateway logs`. A 404 points to the webhook path; a 502 points to the listener or tunnel; a 401 can indicate a signing-secret mismatch or stale event timestamp. Confirm the Client ID and signing secret belong to the same app and the workspace authorization has not been revoked. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:486:| The first @mention returns a pairing code | Enable the member under the workspace's **Member access**, or approve the code in the WebUI pairing dialog, then repeat the prompt. An explicit off switch must be changed in **Member access**; pairing or allowlist changes do not override it. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:487:| Normal comments do nothing | This is intentional. Start a task by @mentioning the app, or continue inside an existing Agent Session. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:488:| Delegating an issue does not start a session | Reconnect the workspace so the installation grants `app:assignable`, then confirm the app can be selected as the issue delegate. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md:489:| The agent can discuss an issue but cannot search or change it | Connect the Linear MCP app from **Configure Linear MCP**. The native channel transports the conversation but does not add issue-management tools. |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/linear-agent.md-490-| Authorization reports missing scopes | Reconnect from nanobot. Do not reuse an authorization URL that omits `read`, `write`, `app:mentionable`, or `app:assignable`. |

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-40-## Scheduled Automations
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-41-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-43-nanobot from the target chat or WebUI topic:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-44-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-53-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-54-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:55:The cron tool supports interval schedules, cron expressions, and one-time
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-56-scheduled tasks. Cron expressions can include an IANA timezone such as
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-57-`America/Vancouver`; otherwise nanobot uses the runtime default timezone.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-58-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:59:Scheduled automations normally deliver the result back to the session where they
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-60-were created. Use them for work that should run on a predictable schedule and
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-61-report each run.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-104-## Heartbeat
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-105-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:106:Heartbeat is for recurring workspace checks that should usually stay quiet. It
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:107:reads `<workspace>/HEARTBEAT.md`, executes active tasks, and sends only useful or
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-108-actionable results to the most recently active chat target.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-109-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-110-Use heartbeat for checks such as "watch this repo for important failures" or
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:111:"periodically inspect this workspace and only tell me when action is needed." Use
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-112-a scheduled automation instead when every run should produce a visible reminder
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-113-or report.
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-121-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-122-- filter by all, active, paused, needs-attention, or system jobs;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:123:- search by task name, message, trigger command, linked topic, schedule, or
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-124-  status;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-125-- sort by next run, last run, updated time, or name;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-126-- run scheduled automations now;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:127:- pause or resume, rename, or delete user-created automations;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-128-- copy the CLI command for local triggers;
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-129-- inspect protected system automations without changing them.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-135-## Delivery and Reliability
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-136-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:137:Automation delivery is workspace-local. Scheduled jobs and local trigger
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:138:deliveries use the same workspace as the gateway.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-139-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-140-Local trigger messages are written to a durable queue. If the gateway is not
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:141:running yet, the message waits in that workspace. If the linked topic is
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:142:already running a turn, the trigger waits until the session becomes idle instead
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-143-of being injected into the active turn.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-144-
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-150-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-151-Each local trigger delivery writes an audit record under
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md:152:`<workspace>/triggers/runs`. Run one gateway consumer per workspace; the local
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-153-queue is not a distributed multi-consumer queue.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/automations.md-154-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/python-ai-agent-sdk.md-56-## Security notes
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/python-ai-agent-sdk.md-57-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/python-ai-agent-sdk.md:58:- The SDK uses the same config, workspace, tools, and secrets as the CLI.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/guides/python-ai-agent-sdk.md:59:- Do not run untrusted prompts with broad file or shell access.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-1-# Image Generation
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-2-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md:3:nanobot can generate and edit images through the `generate_image` tool. Enable the tool in WebUI Settings, then ask for an image normally in chat; the agent decides when to call it and can keep iterating on generated images in the same conversation.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-4-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-5-The feature is disabled by default. Open **Settings → Image**, choose a configured provider and model, enable image generation, and save. The running gateway applies the change immediately. If that screen is not available in your installed version, use the manual config below.
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-12-2. Open **Settings → Image**.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-13-3. Select the provider and image model, then enable image generation.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md:14:4. Save and ask for a simple test image. If the gateway cannot apply the change live, WebUI will prompt you to restart it.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-15-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nanobot-docs/docs/image-generation.md-16-**Manual config**
--
